recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s album cover featuring a central, soft-focus sepia portrait framed by a thick, dark blue border. The layout uses highly condensed, yellow-gold sans-serif typography at the top, organized in a clean, horizontal hierarchy with decorative floral glyphs.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark blue border acts as a heavy frame for the warm, high-key portrait.
The yellow-gold typography provides a high-contrast focal point against the blue header.
The soft, diffused lighting of the subject contrasts with the sharp, geometric lines of the outer frame.
coreInvariants: Thick outer border in a desaturated navy blue.
High-key, warm-toned photography with soft edges.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A close-up portrait occupies the central 70% of the canvas, slightly offset to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, condensed text block at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top text, move down to the subject's eyes, and follow the curve of the shoulder and flower back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy blue margins create a sense of containment and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark frame and the bright, blown-out highlights of the photo.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Small decorative floral glyphs used as separators between text segments.

composition.position: Top third, centered within the blue header
composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by a thin white line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying scales and weights for consistency.
graphicDevices: Double-headed horizontal arrow at the very top edge
Thin white internal border framing the photo
Small floral icons as bullet points

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed verticality of the main title.
Provides the clean, mid-century grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage 1960s-style layout with a thick navy blue border. Inside the border, place a vertical rectangular soft-focus portrait of a person with a warm sepia tone, holding a single large white flower. The lighting should be bright and hazy. Include a thin white line framing the photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed, uppercase sans-serif text in a muted yellow color at the top. Use a large font for the primary title and a smaller font for the secondary list below it. Place a double-headed arrow at the very top and small floral icons between words in the secondary text.

verificationChecks: Is the blue border thick and desaturated?
Is the portrait soft-focus and sepia-toned?
Is the typography ultra-condensed and yellow?
Are there decorative floral glyphs between text segments?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Corporate logos and record label insignias
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the sepia tone doesn't lose all detail in the highlights.
Verify the navy blue is matte and not vibrant.
Confirm the typography maintains a clean, flat appearance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Navy frame + Sepia soft-focus window + Ultra-condensed yellow grotesque type = 1960s Pop Aesthetic.
